x-m-el-job-02.title: Faɗin Gudun Ɗaya da Raka'a Biyu
x-m-el-job-02.goal: Ta amfani da canjin gudun kowane minti (m) zuwa gudun kowane awa (km), nemo da kanka sharadin da zai sa duka darajoji su zama lambobin halitta, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
x-m-el-job-02.material: Mutane biyu a ƙungiyar gudu sun bayyana gudu ɗaya da raka'a dabam-dabam. Ɗaya ya ce x m a minti ɗaya (nisan da ake gudu a cikin minti 1), ɗayan kuma ya ce y km a awa ɗaya (nisan da ake gudu a cikin awa 1). Suna son rubuta lambobin a matsayin lambobin halitta kawai, ba tare da kaso na goma ko kasrori ba.
x-m-el-job-02.thinking.0: Yi amfani da dangantakar canjin raka'a.
x-m-el-job-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharadi.
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.1: Ana bayyana gudu da nisan da aka yi a cikin lokaci ɗaya (matakin sakandare).
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.prompt: Kimanin mita nawa a minti ɗaya ne gudun mutum mai gudu 6 km a awa? Da farko ka ƙiyasta girman.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko mayar da nisan da aka yi a awa 1 zuwa m.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.1: Raba wannan nisan da minti 60 don ƙiyasta nisan da aka yi a minti 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.a: Duba ko ana ɗaukar kusan minti 10 don tafiyar 1 km. Duba alkiblar da ake bi wajen canza raka'a.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.c: Gudu 1000 m a minti ɗaya ya yi daidai da 60 km a awa. Duba rabon minti 1 da awa 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.explain: 6 km a awa yana nufin mita 6000 cikin awa 1; awa 1 kuma minti 60 ne, don haka kusan mita 100 ne a minti 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau'i-nau'i 3 na lambobin halitta daban-daban, gudu x (m) a minti ɗaya da gudu y (km) a awa ɗaya, waɗanda ke nuna gudu ɗaya. Gudun awa ya kasance daga 6 zuwa 20, iyakar gudun da mutum zai iya yi.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bayyana nisan da aka yi cikin awa 1 idan ana gudu x m a minti ɗaya, a km.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi gudu guda ɗaya a awa, sannan ka duba ko gudun minti ɗaya lambar halitta ce.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.2: Idan wasu gudun awa ba sa ba da lambobin halitta, bincika abin da waɗannan gudun suke da shi iri ɗaya.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x da y dole ne su zama lambobin halitta.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c2: x m a minti ɗaya da y km a awa ɗaya ba gudu ɗaya ba ne. Kwatanta nisan da aka yi cikin awa 1, kana amfani da raka'a ɗaya.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Gudun awa yana cikin iyakar da aka kayyade.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Dole ne gudun awa ya kasance daga 6 zuwa 20, har da iyakokin.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.explain: Gudu 100 m a minti ɗaya yana nufin mita 6000 cikin awa 1, wato 6 km a awa. Duk lokacin da gudun minti ɗaya ya ƙaru da 50 m, gudun awa yana ƙaruwa da 3 km. Saboda haka nau'i-nau'i masu yiwuwa su ne 100/6, 150/9, 200/12, 250/15, 300/18.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa 7 km ko 8 km a awa ba su yiwuwa, amma 6, 9 da 12 km suke yiwuwa.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Idan ka canza y km a awa zuwa gudun minti ɗaya, za ka samu kasri. Duba irin y da ake buƙata don a raba ma'aunin kasrin ba tare da saura ba.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lissafa gudun minti ɗaya na 7 da 8 kai tsaye, ka gano dalilin da ya sa suke zama kaso na goma.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Idan ka canza gudun awa zuwa gudun minti ɗaya, ...
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka duba ko nau'i-nau'in da ka ƙirƙira suna bin ƙa'ida ɗaya?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana dalilin ƙa'idar ta hanyar tambayar me ya sa musamman 3 (ko 50)?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Gudu y km a awa idan aka mayar da shi gudun minti ɗaya yana zama 1000×y÷60 = 50y/3 m. Don wannan ya zama lambar halitta, y dole ne ya zama ninkin 3; saboda haka 6, 9, 12 suna yiwuwa, amma 7 da 8 ba sa yiwuwa.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Gudu x m a minti ɗaya yana nufin 60x m = 0.06x km cikin awa 1. Don duka su zama cikakkun lambobi, x dole ne ya zama ninkin 50; a kowane mataki gudun awa yana ƙaruwa da 3.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Idan aka canza gudu y a awa zuwa na minti, ana samun 50y/3, saboda haka y dole ne a raba shi da 3 don ya zama lambar halitta. 6, 9 da 12 suna yiwuwa, amma 7 da 8 ba sa yiwuwa.

x-m-el-job-10.topic: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin da ake da shi ya wadatar
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.ok.c1: Lamba ce cikakkiya a cikin zangon da aka kayyade.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai sannu a hankali, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, yanke hukunci bisa bayanan da aka bayar zuwa lokacin.
x-m-el-job-10.title: Zaɓen tsarin wayar hannu: Shin bayanin wata guda ya isa?
x-m-el-job-10.goal: Koyi cewa bayanan wata ɗaya ko biyu ba su isa zaɓen tsari ba, cewa tsarin da ya fi kyau yana sauyawa idan amfani ya sauya, sannan nemo iyakar sauyin.
x-m-el-job-10.material: Kana son fara amfani da ɗaya daga cikin tsarin wayar hannu guda biyu. Tsarin A yana biyan 30,000 won a wata, ya ƙunshi bayanai har zuwa 10 GB, sannan ana biyan 5,000 won ga kowane GB da ya wuce. Tsarin B yana biyan 42,000 won a wata kuma bayanansa marasa iyaka ne. Ana ƙididdige amfani da cikakkun GB kawai.
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka yayin da bayanai suke ƙaruwa
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.1: Nemo sharadin iyaka (inda fifiko yake juyawa)
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.2: Tantance ko samfurin bayanai ya isa
x-m-el-job-10.prereq.0: Bayyana kuɗaɗe da jimlolin layi (matakin makarantar tsakiya)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta kuɗin tsare-tsaren biyu na kowane wata, sannan ka kwatanta jimillarsu.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kimanta kusan adadin amfani da zai sa kuɗin A da na B su yi daidai.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.info: An yi amfani da bayanan 9 GB a watan da ya gabata.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan za ka zaɓi tsari don amfani daga yanzu, yaya za ka yanke hukunci?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Da amfani da bayanan 9 GB a watan da ya gabata, kuɗin A shi ne 30,000 won, B kuma 42,000 won, saboda haka A ya fi arha. Amma wannan bayanin wata guda ne kawai.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: Ba shi da iyaka, don haka zan samu kwanciyar hankali.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Samun kwanciyar hankali ya bambanta da biyan kuɗi kaɗan. Lissafa kuɗin watan da ya gabata a tsare-tsaren biyu.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: Bisa watan da ya gabata, ya fi arha.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Bayanin wata guda ne kawai, saboda haka har yanzu yana da wuya a yanke hukunci.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.info: A wannan watan ka kalli bidiyoyi da yawa, kana amfani da bayanan 12 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Da bayanan waɗannan watanni biyu, yaya za ka sake duba hukuncinka?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Da 12 GB, kuɗin A shi ne 30,000 + 2×5,000 = 40,000 won, wanda har yanzu ya fi arha da B (42,000 won). Ko da an wuce iyaka, B ba ya zama mafi kyau nan take.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ci gaba da A: shi ma ya fi arha a wannan watan.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Sauya zuwa B: ka wuce 10 GB, saboda haka B ya fi kyau yanzu.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wuce 10 GB ba ya sa B ya fi kyau nan take. Lissafa kuɗin ƙarin adadin.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Bayanan watanni biyu ma har yanzu ba su isa yanke hukunci ba.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Ana sa ran amfani da bayanan a watanni 4 masu zuwa zai zama 8 GB, 13 GB, 14 GB da 15 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane tsari ne ke da ƙaramin jimillar kuɗi a waɗannan watanni 4?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.after: A yana biyan 30,000 + 45,000 + 50,000 + 55,000 = 180,000 won, B kuma yana biyan 42,000×4 = 168,000 won. A ya yi kamar ya fi arha a watanni biyu na farko, amma idan aka haɗa watannin da amfani ya ƙaru, B ya fi arha.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kasancewar A ya fi arha a wasu watanni ba ya nufin jimillarsa ma ta fi arha. Lissafa kuɗin A na kowane wata, sannan ka tara su.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yanke shawarar cewa sun yi daidai ba tare da nemo jimillar ba ba shi da hujja.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.reflect: Da bayanan wata guda da watanni biyu, A ya yi kama da mafi kyau; amma bayan ka ga yadda amfani zai rarrabu nan gaba, hukuncinka ya sauya. Ka yi tunanin ƙarin bayanin da kake buƙata kafin ka kafe a kan hukunci, da kuma adadin amfani da tsarin da ya fi kyau zai sauya.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.prompt: Samar da ƙimomi daban-daban guda 2 na amfani da bayanan wata-wata x GB da za su sa tsarin B ya fi arha da A. (x cikakken adadi ne daga 0 zuwa 40)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafa kuɗin A bi da bi idan x=10, 11, 12, 13.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo ƙimar x da kuɗin A yake fara wuce 42,000 won.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.var.x: Amfani da bayanan kowane wata x (GB)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole x ya zama cikakken adadi daga 0 zuwa 40.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Kuɗin A ya fi na B tsada.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan adadin amfani, kuɗin A bai fi na B ba. Ƙara kuɗin bayanan da suka wuce iyakar ma.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.explain: Kuɗin A shi ne 30,000 + 5,000×(x−10). Yana wuce 42,000 won idan x ya kai 13 ko fiye. A x=12 kuɗinsa 40,000 won ne, saboda haka A har yanzu ya fi arha; a x=13 kuwa 45,000 won ne, don haka B ya zama mafi arha.

x-m-el-job-05.thinking.0: Nemo mafita da dama bisa sharuddan
x-m-el-job-05.title: Daidaita jerin gabatarwa da sharuddan
x-m-el-job-05.goal: Ƙirƙiri jerin gabatarwa da suka cika duk sharuddan, sannan ka bayyana yadda ka ƙirga jimillar jerin yiwuwar ba tare da rasa ko ɗaya ba.
x-m-el-job-05.material:
A wani mataki na biki, ƙungiyoyi A, B, C da D kowannensu yana yin gabatarwa sau ɗaya, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Sharuddan su ne kamar haka.
① A ba zai iya zama na farko ba saboda shirya kayan aiki.
② D ba zai iya zama na ƙarshe ba saboda wani alƙawari.
③ Bidiyon B yana zama hoton baya ga gabatarwar C, saboda haka B dole ne ya gabatar kafin C.
Lambar jeri 1 ita ce ta farko, 4 kuma ita ce ta ƙarshe.

x-m-el-job-05.prereq.1: Tushen ƙirga ta rarraba zuwa yanayi (matakin ƙa’idar jimilla)
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan sharadi ③ kaɗai (B kafin C) aka kiyaye, jerin gabatarwa nawa ne gaba ɗaya ga ƙungiyoyi 4?

x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.explain: Don guje wa asara, (farashin sayar da kuki guda − ƙarin kuɗin kowane kuki) da aka ninka da adadin da aka sayar dole ne ya kai aƙalla jimillar tsayayyun kashe-kashe. x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.acc.0: Ba a buƙatar adadin kukis ɗin da aka shirya don nemo mafi ƙarancin adadin sayarwa, amma ana buƙatarsa don tantance ko wannan buri zai yiwu a zahiri.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s2.prompt: Ka gano cewa kuɗin rumfa 4,000 won ne, marufi kuma 300 won ga kowane kuki, an kuma shirya kukis 60. Rubuta mafi ƙarancin adadin da za a sayar don kada a yi asara, da ribar idan aka sayar da duka 60.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo farashin sayarwa bayan an cire kuɗin kowane kuki.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda za a sarrafa sakamakon rabon tsayayyun kashe-kashe da wannan adadin don a tabbatar da “babu asara.”

x-m-el-job-09.s.s2.model.0: 1,500−300 = 1,200 won ne ke ragewa daga kowanne kuki, kuma tsayayyun kashe-kashe su ne 36,000+4,000 = 40,000 won; saboda haka 40,000÷1,200 = 33.3…, don haka dole a sayar da aƙalla 34. Idan aka sayar da duka 60, ribar ita ce 72,000−40,000 = 32,000 won.

x-m-el-job-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da lissafin ma'aikacin ya fara yin kuskure.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, nuna ko kawai ya ɗauko sakamakon layin da ya gabata ne da kuma sabon bayani da ya ƙara.

x-m-el-job-01.s.s2.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi aminci wajen gane cewa sakamakon 40 L ba shi da ma'ana?
x-m-el-job-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sake maimaita matakan lissafi ya bambanta da ƙiyasta girman abu ta wata hanya dabam da lissafin.

x-m-el-job-01.s.s2.o.b: Yi amfani da faɗin kasan tankin ka ƙiyasta tsayin ruwan idan an zuba 40 L, sannan ka kwatanta shi da tsayin tankin.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s2.o.c: Duba ko amsar ta fito a matsayin cikakkiyar lamba ba tare da kaso na goma ba; idan haka ne, ka yanke hukuncin cewa daidai ce.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s2.r.c: Lamba mai sauƙin karantawa ba lallai ta zama daidai ba. Lamba mai sauƙi ma na iya fitowa daga zato mara kyau.

Idan ka zuba 40 L = santimita kubik 40,000, tsayin ruwan kusan 4 cm ne kawai, amma tankin yana da tsayin 40 cm. Idan ka ƙiyasta girman ta wata hanya dabam da lissafin, kuskuren canjin raka'a zai bayyana.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.prompt: Menene adadin ruwan daidai? Rubuta inda da yadda za a gyara lissafin, ka yi amfani da dangantakar raka'a a matsayin hujja.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin sau nawa ƙarar (hanyoyi uku) take ƙaruwa idan tsawo ya zama sau 100.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan ka san wata dangantaka tsakanin santimita kubik da L, fara da haɗa ta.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Mita kubik 1 daidai yake da ...

x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ban da ƙa'idar canjin raka'a, shin ka yi amfani da ƙiyasin girma a matsayin hujjar cewa 40 L ba daidai ba ne?
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.model.0: Mita kubik 1 daidai yake da 1000 L. Saboda haka mita kubik 0.4 daidai yake da 400 L; idan kuma 40 L ne, ruwan zai kai tsayin 4 cm kawai a kasan tankin (2 m × 0.5 m), wanda ba shi da ma'ana.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.model.1: Tun da 1 m daidai yake da 100 cm, mita kubik 1 yana da santimita kubik 100×100×100 = 1,000,000. L 1 kuma yana da santimita kubik 1000, don haka mita kubik 1 = 1000 L. Saboda haka 0.4 × 1000 = 400 L.
x-m-el-job-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ka samo dangantakar canjin raka'a kai tsaye daga raka'o'in tsawo.

x-m-el-job-04.thinking.2: Duba rabon ta amfani da layin ma'auni.

x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wanne ne yake canzawa tare idan aka kwafa: rubutun ma'auni ko layin ma'auni.

x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba a rubuta tsawo ba, don haka ba za a iya sani ba.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Za ka iya yin ƙiyasin ta amfani da tsawon da ke zane da ma'auni.

x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Da wannan bayani, yaya ainihin tsawon falon zai kwatanta da 6 m?

x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wataƙila ka karkatar da hanyar tunanin yadda zanen ya ragu da yadda ainihin girman yake ƙaruwa.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Har yanzu 6 m ne, domin rubutun ma'auni yana nan yadda yake ko da an kwafa zanen.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lambar da aka buga ba ta canzawa idan an kwafa, amma tsawon da ke zane yana raguwa. Ka bambanta abin da ya canza: lambar ko tsawon.

x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kimanin nawa ne ainihin tsawon falon?
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 3.5 cm daidai yake da 5 m, don haka 1 cm kusan 1.43 m ne, 6 cm kuma kusan 8.57 m ne. Wannan daidai yake da lissafin mataki na biyu. Layin ma'aunin yana raguwa tare da zanen idan an rage shi, saboda haka abin dogaro ne.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan na iya zama darajar da aka samu ta ninka rabon ta hanyar da ba daidai ba. Da farko nemo mita nawa ne 1 cm.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ƙima ce daga amfani da rubutun ma’auni yadda yake. Kwatanta ta da sandar tsawo.

Da aka samu bayanin kwafi, ka koyi cewa rubutun da ainihin girman zane na iya bambanta, sannan ka tabbatar da hakan ta sandar tsawo. Idan sabon bayani ya bayyana, duba zato na wane ɓangare na hukuncinka na baya ya karye.

x-m-el-job-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bambance abin da yake tsayawa yadda yake idan an kwafi zane da abin da yake raguwa tare da shi.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin zato waɗanne ne ba ka bukata idan kana amfani da sandar tsawo don nemo rabo.
x-m-el-job-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bambance ko abin da ka duba lambar ma’auni ce ko ainihin tsawon da ke zane?
